newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials, Novellus settle dispute.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials, Novellus settle dispute.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc and Novellus Systems Inc said Monday they reached a settlement over a patent dispute that calls for Novellus to pay $80 million in damages to Applied Materials.
The companies said they agreed in the settlement to end all outstanding litigation between them and to cross license patents related to certain aspects of chemical vapor deposition.
The companies said Novellus's $80 million payment is for damages for past infringement and a royalty for all future shipments of TEOS-based systems.
The companies said other terms of the settlement are confidential.
